rules.meaning: raw original surface metric stores origarea, not canonical or base area
fresh valbak/imag_val/curvbak/stat/mean/mean_imag/std_error are bzero and not assigned before base copy
original component ordered float32 area sum writes val before merge; initial border normal uses startup precenter sphere metric
canonical metric follows segmentation; merge then retention precede two orig averages; merge does not rewrite initial component val
ripped inside retains previous canonical normal; double sample mean is rounded once independently of white/gray; separate median passes
SFF1 uses raw TMP/mixed normals and vtotal2; subsequent source statistics SFF2 modifies original after base copy, not clone K/H
startup restore precenter canonical then compute metric; correctTopology centers sphere before segmentation, recomputes metric only afterward
merged ordered inside union need not be directly connected; explicit concat order, no reference mapping and no repeat BFS
